The client is a global leader in the sustainable construction industry, focused on delivering innovative building solutions while prioritising environmental and social impact. They foster a collaborative, people-centric culture that emphasizes employee well-being, diversity, and continuous growth in an international setting.

Jobomschrijving

As a Product Manager your responsibilities are:

• Gather and translate customer and market insights into product ideas and improvements
• Oversee the full product lifecycle, from initial concept through launch to discontinuation
• Identify opportunities to improve profitability and expand the global product portfolio
• Track product performance and support forecasting with data-driven analysis
• Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., sales, R&D, marketing) to deliver on strategic goals
• Contribute to long-term planning and initiatives aimed at driving growth in international markets

A successful Product Manager should have:

• Proven experience managing products in an international B2B environment, ideally within the construction sector
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable strategies
• Solid business acumen, including building and managing financial cases and performance metrics
• Technically savvy, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach to innovation
• Effective project manager, capable of handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting
• Excellent communicator who collaborates easily across teams and with external stakeholders
• Adaptable, hands-on, and comfortable working in a dynamic, evolving environment
• Willing and able to travel frequently across regions
• Fluent in English, with strong interpersonal skills to operate in a global context

Our client is a recognized provider of data, analytics, and insights for the automotive industry. With a strong international footprint, the organization supports key market players, including leasing companies, insurers, manufacturers, and importers, in making informed, data-driven decisions.

In Belgium, the company operates through a small, agile team while being fully integrated into a larger international network of experts and analysts.

Jobomschrijving

As Business Analyst BeNeLux, your main responsibilities will be to :

• Produce and maintain residual value forecasts for new and used vehicles across BeNeLux region
• Analyze large datasets using statistical methods and proprietary algorithms to generate accurate market predictions
• Continuously monitor automotive market trends, pricing developments, and competitor activity
• Apply strong market knowledge to complement and refine data-driven models
• Contribute to improving valuation methodologies and analytical tools
• Collaborate with a network of market analysts across Europe to ensure consistency and best practices
• Support commercial teams with insights for client interactions when needed
• Participate occasionally in industry events and client meetings across the region

• Strong analytical mindset with experience working with data (preferably in automotive, leasing, insurance, or related industries)
• Solid understanding of the automotive market, including vehicle pricing and trends
• Experience in data analysis, statistical modelling, or similar analytical work
• Comfortable working with large datasets and improving analytical models
• Autonomous, self-driven, and able to work effectively in a fully remote environment
• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in international, virtual teams
• Fluent in French, Dutch, English

Our client is a global leader in food manufacturing, known for its strong focus on innovation and operational excellence.

The Process Expert plays a key role in optimizing production processes, leading new product introductions, and improving plant performance across liquid and solid chocolate processing operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead new product introduction (NPI), process transfers, and factory trials
• Optimize production lines to improve throughput, reduce waste and losses
• Define and implement process standards, work instructions and recipes
• Collaborate with R&D, quality, engineering and operations teams
• Analyze process performance and identify continuous improvement actions
• Support and coach shopfloor teams on best practices and standards
• Manage process validation linked to chocolate liquid & solid processing
• Drive product industrialization and ensure compliance with quality standards

• Engineering degree (Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial or similar)
• First experience in FMCG / food / process industry
• Strong knowledge of chocolate or similar processing technologies: Mixing, refining, conching, tempering, depositing
• Understanding of rheology and process parameters
• Familiarity with SAP, MES or industrial automation tools
• Hands-on mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to influence, train and engage operational teams
• Fluent in English (and French/Dutch preferred)

What you do

 
• 
You research new applications and functionality for business use cases.

 
• 
You build new processes as well as optimize existing ones.

 
• 
You rollout the template to new factories and countries.

 
• 
You work closely together with the business process owners.

 
• 
You participate in the blueprint and fit-gap.

 
• 
You understand the business processes and requirements.

 
• 
You convert them into a functional design.

 
• 
You configure the system and write functional and technical specifications.

 
• 
You document and test the functionality.

 
• 
You support the business during acceptance and go-live.

 
• 
You play a key role in all phases from the beginning till the end.

 
• 
You work with the latest SAP technologies and applications (including S/4 Hana).

Who you are

 
• 
You have built up profound knowledge of SAP SD (sales and distribution)

 
• 
You are familiar with the business processes and their approach in SAP

 
• 
You have developed analytical skills

 
• 
You have a proactive and solution oriented mindset

 
• 
You prefer working in an informal no-nonsense style

 
• 
You work independently and collaborate in dialogue with colleagues

 
• 
You are interested in a manufacturing environment

 
• 
You are willing to travel occasionally within Europe

 
• 
You speak English (Dutch or French is a plus)

 
• 
You are able to debug programming code

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Diegem at the border with Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

You coordinate and supervise the production, the team, and the workload in our central production kitchen. This kitchen supplies our locations in Antwerp, Brussels, Ghent, and various events.
 

Your responsibilities:
 
 

•  

You organize task distribution, provide guidelines, and manage the kitchen team during bulk production, cooking, packaging, and finishing.
  

•  

Processing and monitoring orders from all outlets.
  

•  

Placing orders with various suppliers.
  

•  

Managing inventory, determining needs, and following up on orders.
  

•  

Creating daily, weekly, and monthly planning for cooking and deliveries.
  

•  

Preparing the kitchen staff schedules.
  

•  

Coordinating task distribution between the day kitchen and the evening shift.
  

•  

Maintaining a clean and orderly working environment and handling kitchen equipment with care.
  

•  

Working in compliance with safety regulations.
  

•  

Monitoring safety and hygiene standards during operations, including food safety, correct labeling, and proper storage in accordance with HACCP standards.
  

•  

Supervising the maintenance of the kitchen, ventilation hoods, and all equipment, in coordination with the cleaning team and other service providers.
  

•  

Communicating with and reporting weekly to the overarching management team
  
 

•  

Minimum of 10 years of experience as a chef.
  

•  

Experience managing multiple outlets and in similar leadership roles.
  

•  

Knowledge of Indian cuisine is required.
  

•  

Strong knowledge of HACCP standards and consistent application thereof.
  

•  

Fluent in spoken and written English.
  

•  

Good computer skills (Excel & Word).
  

•  

A team player who approaches problems quickly and practically.

Our client is a well-established and dynamic company located in Brussels. They offer a stimulating work environment where professionals can grow, develop new skills, and build a long-term career. Due to continued expansion, they are looking for a motivated Administrative Assistant to join their team.

Jobomschrijving

As an Administrative Assistant, you will play a key role in supporting daily office operations. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
• Preparing and formatting documents, reports, and presentations
• Supporting various departments with administrative tasks
• Handling agendas, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments
• Ensuring proper filing and data management
• Assisting with internal communication and basic logistics
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient functioning of the office

• You are graduated in Administration, Office Management, Languages, Business, or equivalent
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Organized, detail-oriented, and eager to take initiative
• Communicative, proactive, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment
• Motivated to kickstart your career in administration and open to learning on the job

Our client is an international and people-oriented company based in Brussels. They are known for their strong company culture, internal mobility, and commitment to developing talent. To support their growing HR department, they are looking for an enthusiastic Junior HR Assistant ready to discover the world of Human Resources.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior HR Assistant, you will support the HR team across a variety of tasks, giving you a broad introduction to the field. Your responsibilities will include:

• Assisting with the recruitment process: job postings, screening CVs, scheduling interviews
• Supporting the onboarding of new employees
• Handling HR administration: contracts, personnel files, absences, certificates
• Preparing HR documents and ensuring updated employee data
• Helping with payroll preparation by collecting and verifying information
• Participating in HR projects such as employer branding, training coordination, or wellbeing initiatives
• Being a point of contact for employees, providing clear and friendly support

• You graduated in HR, Psychology, Office Management, Business, or a related field
• Eager to start your career and develop strong HR skills
• Fluent in French and/or Dutch, with a good command of English
• Skilled in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
• Organized, communicative, and service-minded
• Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable handling confidential information
• A real team player who enjoys working with people

This Junior HR Assistant position gives the opportunity to support core HR processes, from recruitment coordination to employee administration and onboarding. It's the ideal first step for someone who wants to develop strong HR skills and grow within a dynamic, people‑focused environment.

What will you do?

In this role, you combine headhunting top talent with actively building your own client portfolio. You will have the unique opportunity to write our success story in Zaventem right from the ground floor:

• 

Build Your Business: Proactively reach out to corporate clients across the region to map out their recruitment needs and develop long-lasting business partnerships.

• 

Find & Connect: Target and headhunt top talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, modern AI tools, and our existing network.

• 

Assess & Match: Conduct in-depth interviews to uncover candidates' career ambitions and match them with the right company culture.

• 

Drive Results: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from start to finish — from initial client acquisition to contract negotiation and candidate onboarding.

     
Who are you?

No prior recruitment background? That’s completely fine! We look for professionals with the right mindset and strong commercial instinct.

• 

Education: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (in any field).

• 

Language Skills: You are fluent in French and have a strong professional command of English. Good knowledge of Dutch is a clear advantage for our office dynamic.

• 

Commercial Drive: You are target-oriented, proactive on the phone, and motivated by tangible financial and professional growth.

• 

Profile: You combine sharp business acumen with high energy, resilience, and a drive to win.

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. A solid technical understanding matters, but your impact will come through coaching, collaboration, and delivery rather than hands-on implementation.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Keep enough depth in our stack (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services) to contribute to architectural discussions and understand the challenges your team faces. Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

Our Large Account Service department dedicated to large customers implementation projects is looking for new colleagues to join our amazing team. This department was created 5 years ago and is one of the main pillars of Odoo’s turnover growth this year.
 

You will be dealing with Mid-Market & Corporate companies (+100 employees) across Europe in any industry. Their complex business needs will require a high effort of pre-sales analysis and functional advisory to convince them Odoo is the best ERP system to optimize their activity for the long term. 
 

If you are looking for a position where you will value your experience in IT or business consultancy and use your analytical and sales skills to advise large companies, then you are definitely at the right place! 

 

The position
 

​As an Experienced Project Manager, you will manage 
 large customer's Odoo implementation projects. You'll be in direct contact with the clients to help them with the good use of Odoo Software (eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Project, Website...), helped by your team of Business Analysts and Developers.Therefore, you will perform the necessary 
 monitoring and follow up in order to get the project live on time and on budget. 

​You'll start your Odoo journey in the Quick Start Team for few months by working on various SME's projects at the same time to learn the Odoo ways of working. Then, you'll progressively switch to the MMC department and work closely with Business Analysts in order to design and implement specific solutions for our bigger customers. As a Experienced Project Manager you will be involved in several implementations with a team of Business Analysts and Developers that you will have to coordinate. 

As a representative of Odoo during Steering or Project Committee meetings, you will serve as the primary liaison between the client and Odoo teams. You will present project progress, align on strategic priorities, and ensure key decisions are documented and followed through. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and a deep understanding of Odoo solutions are essential. 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Project Management (80%) 

• Design the 
implementation plan 

• Organize, coach and guide your team of Business Analysts through the implementation of the agreed solutions (configuration & development) 

• Monitor project progress, ensuring 
timelines, 
quality, and 
budget are met; communicate status and updates to stakeholders. 

• Apply Odoo’s project governance and best practices to ensure 
high-quality outcomes 

• Track and challenge 
budget estimates and actual 

• Define 
workloads, manage backlogs, and prioritize tasks across project phases 

• Identify 
risks and coordinate mitigation plans 

• Keep clients informed through 
reports and steering committees 

• Oversee the 
full project life cycle, from functional/technical design to deployment 

• Internal improvement (20%) 

• Provide 
feedback to the Product Owners 

• Internal 
coaching & training  

• Feedback for department 
improvement 

Must Have
 
 

• 3 years to 7 years of experience in IT Project Management 

• Fluent in Dutch & English 

French is a plus 

• Strong Business knowledge & Analytical skills 

• Fast learner, able to multitask and manage priorities effectively 

• Good communication/negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive mindset 

• Affinity with the IT world 

• Valid work permit for Belgium
